pr_title: workload: dump stacks before giving up on workload generator
pr_body:
Now, when we see

> E230411 06:56:24.281220 1 workload/cli/run.go:452  [-] 3  Attempt to create
> load generator failed. It's been more than 1h30m0s since we started trying to
> create the load generator so we're giving up. Last failure: failed to
> initialize the load generator: context deadline exceeded

we'll also see a stack trace of all the `workload` goroutines, taken
before the context expired.

This will be helpful to make progress on issues like the below.

Closes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/101215.

Epic: none
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/101304)

Notified flaky test fighters[^1]

comments:
```
E230411 06:56:24.281220 1 workload/cli/run.go:452  [-] 3  Attempt to create load generator failed. It's been more than 1h30m0s since we started trying to create the load generator so we're giving up. Last failure: failed to initialize the load generator: context deadline exceeded
  |   | Error: failed to initialize the load generator: context deadline exceeded
```

Smells like #100038. The PR that caused that one was rolled back. But it was resubmitted yesterday in #100533.

@tbg as oncall - watch out for this kind of failure (see [discussion](https://cockroachlabs.slack.com/archives/C016CAD2HQ8/p1680181859366259)), it might come back in various forms.
@sean- FYI, this might need another fix or rollback?

The cluster indeed looks healthy, so it _could_ be a problem with this PR.

I'm kicking off

```
./pkg/cmd/roachtest/roachstress.sh -c 10 decommission/nodes=4/duration=1h0m0s
```

both on a5d61d2cf2bfc11bd6bdc27dcab32467334fb123 (failed run) and dd237e6b8d9053ad3d993bf7a593bbf3ad229075 (parent of merge commit for https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/100533).

They all passed on a5d61d2cf2bfc11bd6bdc27dcab32467334fb123 and on the other SHA too.
I've poked around the failing `debug.zip` a bunch. The `kv` table does get created, with descriptor ID 106; range r63 is split off for it, but it has zero live bytes. So yes, somehow the workload ... didn't do anything for 90m.

I'll put up a PR that dumps the workload stacks, so we have something to look at next time it happens.
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/101304 is up, going to give it another ten runs with it, maybe I'll get lucky. Edit: nope they all passed.

We still don't know what happened here but now we dump stacks of the workload on this kind of failure, so no reason to keep this open; there isn't a strong indication that the problem is in this test.

I see this error _very_ frequently (> 50% of times) when running a simple `./cockroach workload run tpcc {pgurl:1-4} --seed 4164115085511590841 --tolerate-errors --warehouses 100` on a roachtest (as of yesterday's master). It seems we're blocked on `WarmupConns`:
